trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Plateau Research Intern
abilities: high adaptability to new SCP protocols
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T111 may assist in low-risk documentation tasks. Avoid exposure to cognitohazards.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T111 is an intern-level anomaly researcher with mild parahuman cognitive enhancement, enabling rapid learning and pattern recognition.
addendum_logs: Addendum T111-A: SCP-T111 identified a behavioral loop in SCP-0043 (Oddish).
Addendum T111-B: SCP-T111 corrected a misfiled SCP-0076 (Golem) incident report.
